caption:
Pre-season has started, and Lulu's legs feel like lead.

More running, sprints and gym all at once means heavy, tight legs are pretty common. Sleep, food and a gradual ramp-up in training do most of the recovery work.

Remedial massage can be a helpful extra, often easing that heavy feeling for a while. Timing matters: firmer work a day or two before a hard session, lighter work after a big block. Tell your therapist what your training week looks like.

If a niggle keeps coming back or gets worse with training, that's a job for an assessment. Our remedial massage therapists work alongside our physios at Hybrid Physio. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
